en: Sepia-toned image of a large, ornate seaside-style mansion or palace with mansard roofs, a tall corner tower, stone-and-brick façade, arched windows, balconies, and a pergola-covered terrace. The foreground shows manicured lawns and gardens. On the right side, there is vertical handwritten text in purple ink; the bottom portion of the card is left blank for writing, consistent with an old postcard design.
